**Version:** 1.1
**Author:** Ghost

WebRip downloads complete websites including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images, fonts, and media files. No external dependencies. Works immediately after installation.

- يعمل فور التثبيت بدون أي إعدادات
- تحسين سرعة التحميل

Version 1.1

Bundled wget inside the app – no additional installation required

Works immediately after installation – no setup needed

Improved download speed

Fixed old path search issues

Other improvements and bug fixes

Version 1.0

Initial release

Full website downloading

Terminal-style output

Save to /var/mobile/Documents/WebRip/
